title: CM AI agent
help: Your AI community manager: it reads the comments under your Facebook and Instagram posts and ads, answers in public in one line, writes privately to people who ask for the price (the conversation goes on in Message AI agent, where Dellal takes the order) and hides spam, insults and phone numbers.
off: The CM AI agent is off: comments arrive here but nobody answers automatically.

feed.demoNote: Preview: nothing is sent to Facebook or Instagram, the actions are only recorded here.
feed.hiddenPhone: Phone number: hidden so competitors cannot see it
feed.privatePh: Your private message (it opens the conversation in Message AI agent)…
feed.hiddenRude: Insults: hidden. The complaint went to the team.
feed.bulkWaiting_one: {{count}} new comment is waiting for an answer
feed.bulkWaiting_other: {{count}} new comments are waiting for an answer

posts.title: Posts and ads
posts.help: The product of each post: the CM AI agent uses it to give the price, colours and stock in private. It is guessed from the post's text; change it if needed.
posts.empty: Posts show up here with their first comment.

tester.title: Try the CM AI agent
tester.help: Write a comment like a customer under one of your posts: you see what the CM AI agent would do. Nothing is posted or sent.
tester.demoPreview: Preview: these answers come from the demo rules. On your server, with the AI key, Claude decides.
tester.demoNoKey: Demo answers: add the AI key in Message AI agent › Settings so Claude decides.
tester.demoPilot: Demo answers: Pilotix’s AI is not on yet. As soon as it is, Claude decides.
tester.inPage: In this page, the CM AI agent answers with Claude (your Claude account), with its real instructions and the Darija check. An answer often takes 20 to 60 seconds.
tester.name: Customer name (optional)
tester.commentPh: e.g. ch7al ? · بشحال التوصيل لوهران؟ · Price please
quick: Commandit men 10 jours w ma wsalni walou
tester.result: What the CM AI agent would do
tester.nothing: Nothing: this comment needs no answer.
tester.rule: Decided by a rule (link, insult, banned word or emoji alone): no AI needed.
tester.empty: Write a comment, then “{{run}}”: what the CM AI agent would do shows here.

results.title: CM AI agent results
results.note: Orders: those taken in conversations opened by a private message of the CM AI agent (Message AI agent or the team).

settings.how: How the CM AI agent answers
settings.enabled: The CM AI agent handles new comments
settings.enabledHint: Off: comments arrive here, with no automatic answer.
settings.replyPublicHint: One short line under the comment (“Jawbnakom f privé 📩”). Facebook shows pages that answer more.
settings.showPriceHint: Off (advised): the price only goes in private, competitors do not see it and the customer comes to the conversation.
settings.sendPrivate: Write privately to people who ask
settings.sendPrivateHint: One message per comment, within 7 days (Meta's rule). The conversation opens in Message AI agent, where Dellal goes on selling.
settings.hideSpamHint: Links of other pages, competitors, vulgarity. Hidden: the person and their friends still see it, others do not. A complaint always goes to the team and is hidden only when it contains insults.
settings.hidePhonesHint: Competitors copy numbers left in comments: the comment is hidden and the person gets a private message.
settings.nightRepliesHint: Otherwise night comments are handled in the morning.
settings.delayHint: An answer within seconds looks automatic; a minute looks human.
settings.notes: What to say, or never say, in public
settings.notesHint: One rule per line. Prices, products, stock and delivery fees are read from Pilotix.
settings.notesPh: E.g.: Never talk about competitors. During the sales, say “promo until Thursday”.
settings.bannedHint: One word or phrase per line, on top of the known insults.
settings.channelsHelp: The CM AI agent uses the Meta connection of Message AI agent (page token, app secret, AI key). In your Meta app, also subscribe the page to the “feed” field and Instagram to the “comments” field, with the same webhook address.
settings.instagramHint: Posts and ads of the professional Instagram account.
settings.soon: Soon: TikTok does not open comments to apps yet.
settings.connect: Connect it in Message AI agent › Settings
settings.aiPilotOff: Not on yet (Pilotix turns it on): demo rules
settings.fields: Meta permissions: pages_manage_engagement, pages_read_user_content, pages_messaging, instagram_manage_comments, instagram_manage_messages.
settings.demo: Preview: these are the demo's settings, nothing is sent to Meta.
settings.appSecretNone: Required: without it, comments are not handled (Message AI agent › Settings)
